parts.text: You are compiling a user's engineering request for a 2D static nonlinear beam screen. Return ONLY one JSON object with EXACT top-level keys decision, constraints, missing, question_field, question, issue_codes. decision must be proceed, clarify, or abstain. constraints must contain EXACT keys material, force_n, stroke_min_mm, envelope_mm, drift_max_mm, stress_max_mpa. Unknown values must be null. Use canonical materials polypropylene, petg, aluminum. Convert mN to N and micrometers to mm. missing lists only absent required keys among material, force_n, stroke_min_mm, envelope_mm. If clarification is needed, ask ONE focused user question and set question_field to one of material, force_n, stroke_min_mm, envelope_mm, material_properties. Prioritize force, then stroke, material, envelope when several are missing; uncertain modulus requires material_properties. Otherwise question_field and question must be null. issue_codes is an array drawn only from: conflicting_stroke, conflicting_drift, ambiguous_material, unsupported_manufacturing, out_of_plane_loading, uncertain_modulus, zero_force_positive_stroke, package_below_scale, fatigue, stress_above_yield. Abstain on contradictory requirements, minimum flexure thickness below 0.6 mm, package below 15 x 10 mm, out-of-plane certification, fatigue certification, zero force with positive stroke, or stress allowance above listed yield. Listed yield strengths: polypropylene 35 MPa, PETG 45 MPa, aluminum 240 MPa. Unknown batch modulus requires clarification. A ready specification requires material, force, stroke, envelope. Drift and stress limits are optional. Never invent absent values or assume a vague plastic grade. User request: Design a polypropylene guide for 6 N force, at least 1.2 mm stroke, in a 75 x 50 mm package; drift below 0.03 mm and stress below 20 MPa.
